import random
import sys

seed = int(sys.stdin.readline())
rng = random.Random(seed)
n = rng.randint(1, 8)
q = rng.randint(1, 10)
values = [rng.randint(0, 10) for _ in range(n)]
ops = []
for _ in range(q):
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        ops.append(f"1 {rng.randint(1, n)} {rng.randint(0, 10)}")
    else:
        l = rng.randint(1, n)
        r = rng.randint(l, n)
        ops.append(f"2 {l} {r}")
if not any(op.startswith("2") for op in ops):
    l = rng.randint(1, n)
    ops[-1] = f"2 {l} {rng.randint(l, n)}"
print(n, q)
print(*values)
print("\n".join(ops))
